verses.text: Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yoil ujal yoch jun ab'il chi', a winhaj Hananías yuninal winhaj Azur, aj Gabaón, jun winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, ix lolon winh t'ayin Jeremías in tik t'a templo. T'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil, ix yalan winh:
--Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ol in mak' kanhchaj jun te' syugo winh sreyal Babilonia, haton spoder winh ayem t'a eyib'anh.
Yik wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wak' ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' meltzaj winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yet' masanil heb' anima ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi'. Ol in kanhchitej syugo winh rey chi' ayem t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Hananías chi'.
Ix in tak'wi t'a winh t'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima ayek' t'a templo chi'. Ix walan icha tik:

--Ichokab' chi'. Komonok icha chi' sk'ulej Jehová. Komonok syak'elk'och juntzanh lolonel tzal chi', syak'an ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil anima.
Palta ab' wal juntzanh tas ol wal tik t'ayach yet' t'a heb' anima tik:
Ha heb' schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka', ayik manto onh alji et'ok, yalnak heb' to ol ja owal, yaelal yet' ilya t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión ay spoder.
Palta tato ay junok chekab' tz'alani to ol ja wach'il t'a juntzanh nakión, ato yik ol elk'ochok, ichato chi' ol cheklajelok to a Jehová ix chekan yala', xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel jun te' yugo chi' winhaj Hananías ayoch t'a in jaj, ix skanhchitan te' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' icha tik: --Syal Jehová icha tik: Yik wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wik'el spoder winhaj Nabucodonosor ayoch t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión tik, xchi Jehová chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in b'atxi.
Ayik ix ek'b'at jun pekti' ayik toxo ix smak' kanhchaj te' yugo winhaj Hananías ix yik'el t'a in jaj chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winhaj Hananías to a in Jehová in swala': Ha ach ix a kanhchitej te' yugo nab'a te', a inxo ol wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro sk'exulok te te' chi'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swal icha tik: Ix wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión walnak, yik skan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Anhejtona' nok' kaltakte'al nok', ix wak'kanoch nok' t'a yalanh smandar jun winh rey chi', xchi Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a winhaj Hananías chi' icha tik: --Hananías, ab' wal tas ol wala'. Manhok Jehová ix chekan ala'. Palta a tas tzal syak'och heb' anima yipok sk'ool chi' manh yeloklaj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Ol ach in satel t'a sat lum tik. Yuj a lolonel ix al chi', ix wach' pitb'iel juntzanh anima tik t'ayin, yuj chi' ha t'a jun ab'il tik ol ach chamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha t'a yukil uj t'a jun ab'il chi', ix cham winhaj Hananías chi'.
